newsitem.title: USA: U.S. major meat packers detail holiday schedules.
newsitem.headline: U.S. major meat packers detail holiday schedules.

text.p: U.S. Midwestern major meat packer holiday operating schedules will be staggered Tuesday, Christmas Eve, with some running single shifts, while others will be closed, company sources said.
All will be closed on Wednesday in obervance of the Christmas holiday, the sources said.

"Our plants will be closed Tuesday and Wednesday," said Sherlyn Manson, spokesperson for Farmland Industries. She referred to the cooperative's Farmland Foods unit which operates three hog slaughter plants in Denison, Iowa, Crete, Neb. and Monmouth, Il.

National Beef LP, a subsidiary of Farmland, announced several weeks ago that its Liberal, Kan., beef plant would be closed this week for maintenance of its slaughter facilities. National's beef plant at Dodge City, Kan., will operate except for the Christmas Day holiday, said Dick Moore, National's assistant sales manager.

IBP Inc's 11 beef plants will not be open Tuesday, but its seven pork plants will be operating at reduced hours, said Gary Mickelson, company spokseman. All of IBP's beef and pork plants will be closed Christmas Day.
Cargill Inc unit Excel Corp's beef plant in Dodge City, Kan., will be the only beef plant, out of six, open Tuesday, a company spokeswoman said.
Excel's three hog plants will operate one shift on Tuesday instead of two, said Laurie Johnson. All of Excel's beef and pork plants will be closed on Wednesday, she said.
Excel's six beef plants are located in Texas, Colorado and Nebraska and three pork plants in Iowa, Illinois and Missouri.
Conagra Inc's Swift and Co. hog slaughter and processing plants will be operating at reduced hours Tuesday and will be closed on Wednesday, a company source said.
Officials were unavailable for comment regarding operations this week at ConAgra's beef plants.
Sources at John Morrell and Co. said the hog plant in Sioux City, Iowa will be closed Tuesday, but its Sioux Falls, S.D. hog plant will be open. Both will be closed on Christmas Day.
